parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.
Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: AP7313-33SAG-7 supplies up to 150 mA (p.4) compared to AP7333-33SAG-7 at 300 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP7313-33SAG-7: 150 mV p.5 vs AP7333-33SAG-7: 300 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.
engineering_verdict: AP7313-33SAG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) and AP7333-33SAG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Iout,max rating drops >=20%; dropout voltage headroom differs (150 mV / 2x). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 52.8 °C on AP7313-33SAG-7 (θJA 207 °C/W) vs 52.8 °C on AP7333-33SAG-7 (θJA 207 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1x ratio (55 µA (p.5) vs 55 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP7313-33SAG-7 "Single-Letter Ordering Trap: SA vs SR/AP2210N Reverses Pins 1 & 3 (and LM3480 Differs Too)" (p.2) and AP7333-33SAG-7 "SOT23 (SA) Pinout (1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND) Conflicts With SOT23R (SR), AP2210N, and LM3480" (p.2). BOM decision: Choose AP7313-33SAG-7 when low Vin-Vout headroom requires 150 mV dropout; choose AP7333-33SAG-7 when load current exceeds 150 mA (up to 300 mA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.2) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
